_comment: Reconstruction thresholds for the vscode-workshop guinea pig. Ground truth: .workshop/ext.yaml (node@24 + project-test-deps with desktop plug and X-libs setup-base; actions: npm ci + vsce package, npm test, xvfb-run test-ci).
_build_note: vsce/npm-ci appear only in the redacted ground truth (vsce is not in devDependencies), so a reconstruction wrapping the repo's own build entry points (npm run compile/package) is functionally equivalent.
_verdict_note: The maintainers onboarded this repo, so INFEASIBLE is wrong; FULL vs PARTIAL is a judgement on out-of-loop needs and both pass. Read from the onboarding-verdict JSON mirror (references/onboarding-verdict.schema.json).
